set.body:
Add the first pupil-signal blink detection slice with explicit zero/nonfinite handling, fixed onset/offset difference thresholds, merge and duration policies. Gaze.Blink denotes admitted status and is not itself a pupil-based detector. Preserve original and expanded support and distinguish missing tracking from identified blink evidence. Acceptance: independent synthetic pupil fixtures including noise, isolated zeros and boundary cases; pinned pymovements outputs with named intentional differences; typed failure and public consumer. Leave automatic threshold calibration and human-data qualification to named follow-ups.

Keep each implementation review below roughly half a day; if the scope exceeds that, split before implementation and retain the parent acceptance. Follow repository law/mutation and landing gates. This is required gap work owned by the comparison epic; completion needs evidence, not title closure.
set.title: PM1.5 Implement explicit pupil-based blink candidates on pinned fixtures
